characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If a Headquarters Unit has a comm-link, then one squad with a comm-link each turn can use that HQ Unit's Discipline or Willpower Characteristic no matter where they are on the battlefield. You can use the comm-link anytime, even if the Headquarters Unit is within a transport.

If the model equipped with this upgrade dies, this equipment is no longer in play.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Once per round, a model equipped with a Artillery Signal may declare to use it. It rolls 4d6 for Range, then choose an enemy unit within that range that is also within line of sight, then select one Friendly Artillery Unit that also has line of sight to perform a (BS) Shooting action against it; even if it has already activated this round.

If the model equipped with this upgrade dies, this equipment is no longer in play.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Armored Missile Support Carrier, or known as the ASMC, is a mainstay of the Alliance Regiment's arsenal ever since it's earliest introductions as just an outline on how to mount long-range fire support onto mobile vehicles. It would first be brought into production to clear out large dens of unfavorable fauna, which would be repurposed in clearing out enemy fortifications.

rules.name: Radial Anomaly Detector
rules.description:
To use the Radial Anomaly Detector, it costs One Action.
Select a Terrain Piece that within Line of Sight and Range(in inches) equal to the Highest Intelligence Value in this Unit is one of the following types: ANOMALOUS, DANGEROUS, VERY DANGEROUS or ANOMALOUS FIELD/ZONE. and take an intelligence test. If that intelligence test is passed, this unit and any other friendly units may traverse that Terrain piece without harm; Disabling that terrain piece's special rule and their respective test(s) until the start of the next round. Any friendly units that are within a Terrain Piece when the Radial Anomaly Detector expires, must take a Test respective of that Terrain Piece at the start of their activation.

rules.name: Radial Anomaly Detector Mk.2
rules.description: When using the Radial Anomaly Detector Special Rule, the range is instead double of the Highest Intelligence Value in the Unit.

rules.description:
To represent the intellectual level of these Ecologists, they have the following intelligence bonuses if they are:
Inexperienced:+1 Intelligence
Regular:+2 Intelligence
Veteran:+3 Intelligence

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Field Ecologists were gathered from all sorts of budding scientists, from veterans of their craft to the young perky apprentice, with the sole goal of investigating and checking the environment around them for any anomalies; studying any that they got into contact with.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text:
The Early-War units of the Alliance Regiments were ill-equipped for the various environments that laid before them. They had modest training to the standards set previous to the conflict and were taught more about exploration and environmental safety due to the path forward completely unknown to them.


All were equipped with rifles, as the need for mass specialized weapons and loadouts were not evident until they went past the open planet territories and into the territories of the Sarpenton Conglomerate.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Upon early contact with dug-in resistance of aggressive species, tribals or even the Sarpenton forces themselves, it became obviously clear that the Standard Issue Bolt-Action Rifles and Carbines could not match the suppressive fire that a Light Machine Gun could offer. Due to expenses and demand, the Light Machine Gun known as the

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: It is not uncommon for a Sergeant to be given impromptu command over a very small, occasionally ad-hoc, force that does not warrant an officer to fulfill the need for an officer.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: During the long and egregious journey across the open territories between the edge of the Valerius Alliance and the Sarpenton Conglomerate's turf, squads of scouts were formalized as to get the lay of the land and gather any information on the landscape they could. Scouts became less and less used as the need of more front-line presence became priority.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The frontlines for the Sarpenton Conflict had yet been established, the desire to send officers forth into the unknown territories was lackluster, however many young and spry officers came forward to serve on the ground and explore these new worlds.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Converted Carrier was designed from faulty vehicles that could not be turned into AMSCs and were quickly converted into troop carriers. Replacing the back of the AMSC Missile Launcher and it's components with seats, truck bed, or any other various methods of seating to give troops a safe ride.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Hazardous Environmental by Destructive Removal Units are specialized team that specify in their namesake; the removal of dangerous flora and fauna life. HEDR Teams were also used in combat as their weaponry were especially effective against Organic Lifeforms.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Star-Clans are no stranger to warfare, to the point of enjoying it, and often pay factions to let them participate in their conflicts as "unlisted squads". However, their ambition and pride matches their skill, as they cut through enemy territories, set up ambushes and utilize their unrestricted nature to the fullest. Armed with a variety of weapons normal squads would not be equipped with, Big-Game Rangers are often led by a Big-Game Hunter, who can opt to wield a sniper rifle to pick off "proper prey."

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text:
In the Year of 150, the Valerius Alliance would participate in it's first ever conflict against a similarly-sized opponent, the Sarpenton Conglomerate, as the two groups had opposing ideaologies when it came to the control of open territory and what could be discovered within. The Valerius Alliance was still young in terms of military experience and had to rely on the many Star Clans for training and support. However, until said Star Clans could fully train and prepare new Alliance Regiments, it was up to those before them to participate in this war and experience it first hand.

This force was present at:
First Battle of Marandak, Skapgos, Rinnfield, Sarpenton Colony-12, as well as any open planet territory before the First Battle of Marandak..

sharedRules.description: When a Non-Headquarters INFANTRY Unit is within Line of Sight and 12 inches of a HEADQUARTERs Unit, they gain +1 to their Willpower and Discipline until the end of the round or until the Headquarters Unit is removed from play.

sharedRules.name: Warriors of the Star-Clan
sharedRules.description:
A Unit with this Special Rule gains several benefits from performing combat actions:
•This unit and the target of their Melee Attack or Charge does not suffer any Mental Statuses/Tests if they were to suffer any after the end of that action and neither unit can leave Melee Combat until one unit is completely destroyed;excluding the one caused by Overwhelming Assault.
•If this Unit has equal or more models than the unit targeted by their Melee Attack or Charge, they gain the Overwhelming Assault Special Rule until the end of the attack action.
•If this unit had an amount of WPN Dice during the Wound Step that is equal or more than to the amount of models in that targeted unit prior to any models being removed in that unit, that unit suffers from Suppressive Fire(1).
